_family_b_substitution: Family B was google:gemini-3.1-pro-preview until 2026-08-20. It hit the Gemini API's DAILY per-model cap (generate_requests_per_model_per_day, limit 250) with an ~11h reset; gemini-pro-latest aliases the same exhausted bucket, gemini-3.7-flash returned 503, and only flash tiers had quota left. A flash model is not frontier, so substituting one would have satisfied R6's letter while making its claim false. Swapped to Anthropic's flagship instead, with Hank's sign-off. CONSEQUENCE, stated plainly: the judge (claude-sonnet-4-6) now shares a family with frontier B. No model scores itself -- they are different models -- but the project's own stricter 'judge is a third family' rule is relaxed. Exposure is bounded: constraint pass/fail is 100% programmatic and the judge scores task-quality only, which drove 2 of 14 failures in the openai cells.
